thread:
support_anna: received a ticket from ACME about API 5xxs during heavy burst in us-west-2, customer says ~200 concurrent requests -> many 504s and timeouts. escalation to infra.
customer_ops_john: "we saw timeouts at 2026-03-15T18:04Z, request ids: r_8a3f,r_8a41 — can provide logs"
support_anna: adding basics: customer on hosted inference, model: gpt-3x-8k-redwood-quant, route pinned to us-west-2, usage spike started at 18:02 UTC
deploy-bot: alert: p50 latency spike on gateway-api-prod-usw2 (18:02 -> 18:07), 5xx rate 18% peak :rotating_light:
ops-leo: can someone paste the gateway logs and scale events? suspect scale-up lag
eng-sre-mike: eyeballing metrics — HPA didn't scale until ~18:05. KEDA ScaledObject metrics show no increase in trigger due to mismatched queue metric name. There is a known annotation mismatch: scaledobject uses queue-length but our queue exporter reports pending_requests.
infra-alia: copying relevant excerpt from kube events:
```
Events:
  Normal  Scaled  10s   keda-operator  Successfully scaled 
  Warning FailedMount  30s kubelet       Could not attach volume
  Normal  Pulling  2m kubelet  Pulling image "redwood/inference:latest"
```
ops-leo: hmm also seeing node pressure around the same time causing pods to be scheduled slower (~30s extra). combined with warmup (model init ~40s) -> requests time out
eng-sre-mike: customer saw 504s at gateway because backend pool didn't have warmed replicas. KEDA pollInterval=30s and cooldown=300s here — poll not triggering due to wrong metric name. HPA minReplicas=0 so cold start happened
support_anna: customer asking for repro steps and short-term mitigation
infra-alia: mitigation suggestions (short term):
- increase HPA/KEDA minReplicas to 1 for that tenant
- patch ScaledObject metric name to "pending_requests" (our exporter)
- lower KEDA pollInterval to 5s for bursts, reduce cooldown
- bump readinessProbe initialDelaySeconds to avoid routing to not-ready pods
eng-sre-mike: longer-term: prewarm strategy / prefix caching + KV warm boot, model warm snapshots on disk, and ensure node auto-provisioning faster
ops-leo: quick commands I ran:
```
kubectl -n inference get scaledobject acme-scaled -o yaml | grep -A3 triggers
# patch to fix metric
kubectl patch scaledobject acme-scaled --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/triggers/0/metadata/queueName","value":"pending_requests"}]'
```
customer_ops_john: after patching metric name and setting minReplicas=1 we saw success — 5xx dropped to <1% in next 3 mins. thanks.
support_anna: asked customer if they can tolerate 1 replica baseline, they agreed for now — created ticket for engineering to propose autoscale policy change and prewarm feature
eng-sre-mike: follow-up action items:
- create runbook entry: verify scaledobject metric names on onboarding (owner: eng-sre-mike)
- change default KEDA template to use pending_requests (infra-alia)
- expose per-tenant minReplica opt in console (product)
ops-leo: adding note: also watch node provisioning latency in us-west-2 during burst hours — file ticket with cloud infra
deploy-bot: deploy pr #4127 rolled out config change to scaledobject template (staging)
support_anna: customer satisfied for now, will monitor next 24h and escalate if any regressions :white_check_mark:
eng-sre-mike: closing loop — will schedule a postmortem if we see recurrence. thanks team.
